description: Not charged. Is this x402 seller or remote MCP server covered, and what did its latest unpaid probe show? For MCP server hosts: last handshake state (ok, auth_required, handshake_failed, unreachable, or blocked = not contacted because the URL, a redirect or its DNS points somewhere our rules don't allow), protocol version, tool count and tools hash. Returns status, whether the 402 challenge was valid, quoted vs listed price and payTo, freshness (age, stale flag) and the receipt link. Use before paying any x402 seller. Cap: 1000 per client IP (IPv6 /48) per UTC day, then an error preflight_cap. A key allows 25000 per key per UTC day. No public price is listed for a key.
